quest.title: A-Toymaking We Shall Go: Core Propulsion
quest.description: At last, the final step in the toymaking process has arrived. If you complete this final step, production can begin proper, but will this process really produce any toys?
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

talks.objective: Go to Ritou and look for Bertrand

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: Phew! Wow, that was close...

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: So close, yes, very close indeed...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Bertrand, are you alright? You're sweating all over, and you look like you might collapse at any moment!

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: I "look like I might collapse," eh? Nay, I've already done so, yes indeed!

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: Heh, almost! Almost. But thanks to some emergency adjustments, performed triple-quick-time by yours truly, the process stabilized.

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: The elements are beginning to slowly fuse with the source materials we collected as we speak.

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: Indeed, that was a really close shave! If I hadn't been able to control the elemental energy, I'd probably be competing with the Naganohara family's fireworks for highest recorded altitude right now.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I thought you said it won't explode.

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: I said that the toys wouldn't explode — I never guaranteed that the machine that makes them would be similarly stable.

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: But honestly, it's thanks to your help in this experiment that we even got this far. If I had tried doing this in one go from the start, I don't think there'd be anything left of the Great Machine, never mind there being any toys.

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: Alright then. This is the final step, also known as "Core Activation."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon remembers you mentioned this had to do with elemental creatures, right?

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: Precisely. Elemental life forms are constantly being powered by the elements. Collecting this motive force and adding it to our machine is the final step.

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: If I can make the toys, then I can keep making them. Then I can pay off my debt, earn a good sum, and live out my days in Inazuma in peace...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? Not going back to Fontaine?

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: Fontaine... Ah, Fontaine.

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, you have never been to Fontaine, I suppose. If you had, you would know...

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: For some people, it is a most convenient place to live. But for others, it is naught but a place of grief and disappointment.

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: The energy system there is very special, and no one knows how long it can be sustained. Thus, we must find alternative energy solutions before it all comes crashing down.

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: And yet, change is even harder than we can imagine. The result of all this being... that I must now research alternative energy, alone and away from Fontaine.

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: The Great Machine, too, is a product of that research, which is why it remains somewhat unstable and at risk of exploding if not handled with the utmost care...

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: But someday—someday! Someday, I will find a good energy solution.

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: And then I shall return to Fontaine.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Bertrand...

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: Well, let's not talk about such things now. On to our final process.

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: #My standard of living in Inazuma before I can return to Fontaine depends on you, {NICKNAME}!

talks.objective: Collect 3 portions of Core Propulsion by defeating 3 Slimes

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: How is the final process going? Well, I'll bet that defeating elemental creatures was no challenge for an experienced adventurer like yourself, eh?

talks.objective: Collect 4 portions of Core Propulsion by defeating 2 Specters
Collect 4 portions of Core Propulsion by defeating 1 Hypostasis
Return the Material Collector to Bertrand

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: In any case, that's all our processes completed.

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: #Hmm... How about this, {NICKNAME}? How would you like to be the one to place the Material Collector upon the machine?

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: Haha! I have no idea what's going to be made — oh, the expectation!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, you don't know what sort of toy will come out?

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: Why, that's the fun of the Great Machine! It responds to and processes different materials differently.

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: What you've brought shall determine what gets made... So now then, give it a go!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is this really a toy made by a machine from Fontaine?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Hmm, this just doesn't fit with my image of Fontaine.

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: Ah, but you see, making goods only in Fontaine's image is no way of guaranteeing mercantile success.

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: To tell the truth, this production process does include my various gleanings from studying local popular culture. After all, you must win the people's hearts to earn your welcome.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Will this stuff really be popular, though?

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: *cough* Now, I am sure that there might be some early misunderstandings, but so long as we persevere and continue to improve on our work, I'm sure that they will someday be moved!

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: Whatever the case may be, we have completed this first production cycle.

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: How did you find it? Fascinating, no?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It was decent.

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: Hehe, alright. Hmm, I see, so this is what we can produce using these material ratios. Well, in that case, I shall keep this in storage... and also, this voucher is for you.

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: As for this voucher, you can use it to redeem a robot with the same design as this one for free! If you like this model, then you need only redeem it using this voucher... Well, once we have established a stable production flow, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: This is our first robotic toy, after all, so there are still some examinations to be done. We can't be producing exploding gadgets all the time, now can we?

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: Hmm, and now, let's read the record of issues caused during the test run... It seems that we must make some adjustments to improve our efficiency.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, you're actually pretty serious about all this, aren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: Of course I am. As a person living alone in a faraway land, this machine and my creativity are all that sustain me.

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: I mean, the Doushin who arrested me previously called these "bizarre tricks." Hah! Well, I'll teach 'em to look down on these "tricks."

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: In any case, I must make some adjustments first such that I'll be able to begin mass production shortly.

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: #Do come and lend me your aid when that time comes as well, alright, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: Alright, go over to the Great Machine to give production a go. Let's see what you end up creating.
